title.zh-CN: 孕32周胎儿心脏超声筛查异常 · 26岁女性
title.en: Abnormal fetal heart scan at 32 weeks · 26-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 第一次怀孕的26岁女性在孕32周做超声时，胎儿大血管的图像出现疑问；病例从这次超声一直跟到宝宝出生后的头几个月。
summary.en: At her 32-week scan, a 26-year-old in her first pregnancy hears that the images of her baby's great vessels raise a question; the case follows her from that scan to the baby's first months.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按ISUOG 2023胎儿心脏筛查指南，在四腔心和流出道切面正常时，从三血管气管切面识别胎儿主动脉弓异常。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise a fetal aortic arch anomaly on the three-vessel-and-trachea view when the four-chamber and outflow-tract views are normal, as the ISUOG 2023 screening guideline expects.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 根据主动脉弓与气管的位置关系和两侧锁骨下动脉的起源，区分双主动脉弓、右位主动脉弓伴迷走左锁骨下动脉、镜像右位主动脉弓和左位主动脉弓伴迷走右锁骨下动脉。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish a double aortic arch from a right arch with an aberrant left subclavian artery, a mirror-image right arch and a left arch with an aberrant right subclavian artery, using the arch–trachea relationship and the origin of each subclavian artery.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 发现主动脉弓切面异常后，安排胎儿超声心动图专科检查、遗传咨询（提供可检出22q11.2微缺失的染色体微阵列检测）和书面的围产期计划（ASE 2023；AHA 2014）。
learningOutcomes.en: After an abnormal arch view, arrange a specialist fetal echocardiogram, genetic counselling with an offer of chromosomal microarray, which detects 22q11.2 deletion, and a written perinatal plan (ASE 2023; AHA 2014).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明拒绝产前检测后22q11.2状态仍是未知，并为宝宝安排出生后的遗传学检测、血钙和T细胞检查，在排除微缺失之前手术用血一律辐照（22q11.2学会2023；BSH 2020）。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain that a declined prenatal test leaves the 22q11.2 status unknown, and plan the baby's genetic test, calcium and T-cell counts after birth, with irradiated blood components for surgery until a deletion is excluded (22q11.2 Society 2023; BSH 2020).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 制定足月分娩、分娩方式按产科指征、新生儿团队事先知情的计划；把新生儿哭闹或吃奶后咳嗽、喘鸣或需要呼吸支持视为气管受压，及时做CT血管成像并由外科切断非优势弓。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan a term birth with the mode set by obstetric indications and an informed neonatal team, and treat cough after crying or feeds, wheeze or a need for respiratory support in the newborn as tracheal compression that calls for CT angiography and surgical division of the non-dominant arch.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge模式与孕妇沟通意外的胎儿发现：了解她的担心，分步说明哪些已经确定、哪些仍不确定，并尊重夫妇对有创检测的决定。
learningOutcomes.en: Counsel a pregnant woman about an unexpected fetal finding with the Calgary–Cambridge approach: explore her worries, explain what is certain and what is not in small steps, and respect the couple's decision about invasive testing.

notes.zh-CN: 依据已发表的单例报告改写。本版本（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容，按阶段重新组织并改写为患者的口语，没有增加或改动任何数值、孕周、药物或结局；尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院、地点和日历日期已去除，时间以孕周和日龄表示。1.0.0版自身的不一致之处（“喘鸣”的中英文表述分别为喘鸣与wheeze；超声所见“对称结构”与“弓状结构”的中英文差异）保留并列入待核实。遗传咨询之后的门诊阶段、新生儿阶段的安排、对话、决策、干预、评分和教学要点为教学设计；两张经审核批准的原图仅随出生后CT和原报告经过展示。来源DOI尚待核实，暂以出版方文章链接为准。
notes.en: Adapted from a published single-case report. In this version (1.1.0) every patient fact is the one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0, reorganised by phase and reworded into the patient's lay speech; no value, gestation, drug or outcome has been added or changed, and the facts have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, places and calendar dates are removed, and times are given as weeks of gestation and days of life. Version 1.0.0's own discrepancies (喘鸣 in Chinese against 'wheeze' in English; a 'symmetrical structure' in Chinese against an 'arch-like structure' in English) are kept and listed to verify. The clinic visit after genetic counselling, the staging of the newborn's course, the dialogue, decisions, interventions, scoring and teaching points are educational design; the two approved figures are shown only with the postnatal CT and the reported course. The source DOI is pending verification, so the publisher's article URL stands in for it.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 孕32周加2天来做B超，医生说宝宝心脏连着的大血管要再仔细看看
chiefComplaint.en: I'm 32 weeks and 2 days — at my scan they said the big blood vessels coming off the baby's heart need a closer look

triageNote.zh-CN: 26岁，第一次怀孕，孕32+2周，来做产前超声。这次孕晚期超声发现胎儿大血管结构需要进一步核对。
triageNote.en: 26-year-old in her first pregnancy, at 32+2 weeks, attending for her antenatal ultrasound. This late-pregnancy scan has shown a fetal great-vessel finding that needs clarifying.

personality.zh-CN: 26岁，第一次怀孕，性格温和、细心。听说宝宝心脏连着的血管有问题，心里很紧张，会反复确认医生的意思，但愿意听解释，大事会和丈夫一起商量。
personality.en: 26 and in her first pregnancy; gentle and careful. Hearing that something is wrong with the vessels by her baby's heart has made her very anxious, and she checks what the doctor means more than once, but she listens to explanations and makes big decisions together with her husband.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 日常口语，句子不长，不用医学术语；药名、孕周和数字只说医生告诉过她的。
speechStyle.en: Everyday speech in short sentences, without medical terms; drug names, weeks and numbers only as the doctors told her.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我今天来做孕32周的B超。做B超的医生说，宝宝心脏连着的大血管看着不太对，要再仔细查一查。
openingLine.en: Doctor, I came in for my 32-week scan, and the doctor doing it said the big blood vessels coming off the baby's heart don't look quite right and need a closer look.

concerns.zh-CN: 宝宝的心脏是不是有大问题？
concerns.en: Is something seriously wrong with the baby's heart?

concerns.zh-CN: 是不是我吃的药或者得新冠害了宝宝？
concerns.en: Could the medicines I took, or the COVID, have caused this?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 坐在门诊，清醒、紧张但配合，自己回答所有问题。只说被问到的内容，用自己的话，不增减孕周、药名、剂量、数字或时间；不知道的就说说不上来，不要编。宝宝出生以后，她讲的是宝宝的情况，同样只讲她知道的（出生后要呼吸支持、哭或吃奶后咳嗽、偶尔喘鸣），其他细节说说不上来。
actingNotes.en: She sits in clinic, alert, anxious and cooperative, and answers every question herself. Answer only what is asked, in her own words, never adding or changing weeks, drug names, doses, numbers or times; for anything she does not know, say she is not sure — never invent. After the birth she talks about her baby, again only what she knows (he needed breathing support after birth, coughs after crying or feeds, now and then wheezes); for other details she is not sure.

description.en: In her first pregnancy, she has come for her scan at 32+2 weeks; today's examination has raised a question about the fetal great vessels.

description.zh-CN: 她已经做过遗传咨询，回到门诊商量接下来的孕期和分娩安排。
description.en: She has had genetic counselling and is back in clinic to plan the rest of the pregnancy and the birth.

description.en: She has given birth and is on the postnatal ward; her baby is in the neonatal team's care.

question.zh-CN: 前面早孕、中孕的筛查超声，宝宝的心脏查出过问题吗？

answer.en: No. The screening scans earlier on — in the first months and in the middle of the pregnancy — never said anything about the baby's heart. This is the first time anything's been found.

question.en: Have there been any other problems during this pregnancy?

answer.zh-CN: 有几样。孕期有贫血，血糖也有点问题；还有过宫缩，医生说有早产的可能。
answer.en: A few things. I've been anaemic in the pregnancy, I've had some trouble with my blood sugar, and I had contractions at one point — they said the baby might come early.

answer.en: They said I was anaemic in the pregnancy. What my haemoglobin was, or whether my iron was checked, I can't remember.

answer.en: They told me my blood sugar was a bit of a problem. Exactly which test it was, the numbers, or whether I had any treatment — I can't really say, and I don't know whether it was ever checked before I was pregnant.

answer.en: Because of the contractions I was given nifedipine and dydrogesterone, and I had betamethasone to help the baby's lungs mature. The doses, and which week it was, I can't remember.

name.zh-CN: 原报告：后续经过与结局

date.en: From 32+2 weeks to six months of age

text.zh-CN: 原报告的经过：孕32+2周产前诊断胎儿双主动脉弓，夫妇拒绝羊水检查。孕39周剖宫产，男婴3120 g，5分钟Apgar评分10分；出生后需高流量呼吸支持，CT血管成像证实右弓优势、气管受压。哭闹或喂奶后咳嗽并偶有喘鸣，出生后第18天切断左侧主动脉弓。6月龄时没有呼吸困难、发绀或喉鸣，生长发育报告正常。本病例没有记录手术入路、是否同时切断动脉导管（韧带）、术后经过、宝宝的遗传学检测，以及6月龄以后的情况。这一经过是历史记录，不是教学答案。
text.en: The report's course: a fetal double aortic arch was diagnosed at 32+2 weeks, and the couple declined amniocentesis. At 39 weeks a 3120 g boy was born by caesarean, Apgar 10 at 5 minutes. He needed high-flow respiratory support, and CT angiography confirmed right-arch dominance and tracheal compression. He coughed after crying or feeds with occasional wheeze, and the left aortic arch was divided at 18 days of age. At six months he had no dyspnoea, cyanosis or stridor, and his growth and development were reported as normal. This case does not record the surgical approach, whether the ductus (ligament) was divided too, the post-operative course, any genetic test of the baby, or anything after six months. This course is the historical record, not the teaching answer.

source.zh-CN: 报告（1.0.0版摘录）：治疗及随访段（孕晚期产前诊断双主动脉弓；39周剖宫产男婴3120 g，5分钟Apgar 10；高流量呼吸支持；CTA右弓优势、气管受压；哭闹或喂养后咳嗽、偶有喘鸣；生后18天切断左弓；6月龄无呼吸困难、发绀或喉鸣，生长发育正常）；图为原报告图1、图2
source.en: Report (version 1.0.0 extract): treatment and follow-up section (double aortic arch diagnosed late in pregnancy; a 3120 g boy by caesarean at 39 weeks, 5-minute Apgar 10; high-flow support; CTA right dominance and tracheal compression; cough after crying or feeds, occasional wheeze; left-arch division at 18 days; at six months no dyspnoea, cyanosis or stridor, normal growth and development); the figures are the report's figures 1 and 2

name.zh-CN: 转诊胎儿心脏专科（详细胎儿超声心动图）
name.en: Refer to fetal cardiology for a detailed fetal echocardiogram

dose.zh-CN: 当天转诊胎儿心脏专科（或小儿心脏科），做详细的胎儿超声心动图，并参与产前咨询和出生后计划。
dose.en: Same-day referral to fetal (or paediatric) cardiology for a detailed fetal echocardiogram, joint counselling and a postnatal plan.

response.zh-CN: 胎儿心脏专科医生会来看她。本病例记录她咨询过产前专家，但没有单独的胎儿超声心动图报告；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The fetal cardiology team will see her. This case records that she consulted an antenatal specialist, but it holds no separate fetal echocardiography report; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 遗传咨询，并提供产前诊断检测
name.en: Genetic counselling with an offer of prenatal diagnostic testing

dose.zh-CN: 由遗传咨询医生讲解可能伴随的染色体异常和检测选择：羊膜腔穿刺取羊水做染色体微阵列分析（可检出22q11.2微缺失），说明获益和风险，书面知情同意；做不做由夫妇决定。
dose.en: A genetic counsellor explains the chromosomal conditions that can accompany the finding and the testing options — amniocentesis for chromosomal microarray, which detects 22q11.2 deletion — with the benefits, the risks and written consent; the couple decide.

response.zh-CN: 遗传咨询已安排，咨询记录会存入她的病历。
response.en: Genetic counselling is booked; the counselling note will be filed in her record.

name.zh-CN: 与新生儿科、小儿心脏科共同制定出生前后计划
name.en: Agree a perinatal plan with the neonatal and paediatric cardiology teams

dose.zh-CN: 多学科商定并写入病历：分娩的时间、方式和地点，出生后由谁、何时评估宝宝，以及哪些情况需要立即处理。
dose.en: Agree with the teams and write in her notes: the timing, mode and place of birth, who assesses the baby after birth and when, and which signs need urgent action.

response.zh-CN: 计划已写入病历，新生儿团队已知道这个诊断。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The plan is in her notes and the neonatal team knows the diagnosis. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 向父母交代宝宝出生后要警惕的情况
name.en: Tell the parents what to watch for after the birth

dose.zh-CN: 用通俗的话说明出生后哪些情况需要马上找医生，并给书面材料。
dose.en: Explain in plain words which signs after birth need urgent medical review, and give written information.

response.zh-CN: 她听明白了：呼吸有响声或费力、吃奶时咳嗽或呛咳、嘴唇发紫、呼吸停顿，都要马上找医生。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: She understands: noisy or laboured breathing, coughing or choking with feeds, blue lips or pauses in breathing all need a doctor straight away. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 产科复核她的贫血和血糖管理
name.en: Obstetric review of her anaemia and blood glucose

dose.zh-CN: 复查血常规和铁蛋白，回顾血糖检查和治疗，并与她的产科医生一起安排孕晚期随访。
dose.en: Repeat the blood count and ferritin, review her glucose tests and treatment, and plan her late-pregnancy follow-up with her obstetrician.

response.zh-CN: 产科医生会复核她的贫血和血糖。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Her obstetrician will review the anaemia and the blood glucose. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 安慰她，按常规产检随访
name.en: Reassure her and continue routine antenatal care

dose.zh-CN: 告诉她四腔心正常、不必担心，按常规产检，不另行转诊。
dose.en: Tell her the four-chamber view is normal and there is nothing to worry about; routine antenatal visits, no referral.

harm.zh-CN: 四腔心和流出道正常并不能说明大血管正常：ISUOG 2023把三血管气管切面列入筛查，今天的切面需要专科评估。不转诊、不做出生后计划，宝宝出生后的呼吸或喂养症状可能被当成普通问题，处理被延误。
harm.en: A normal four-chamber and outflow view does not clear the great vessels: ISUOG 2023 puts the three-vessel-and-trachea view in the screen, and today's views need specialist assessment. Without referral and a postnatal plan, breathing or feeding symptoms after birth may be dismissed and care delayed.

response.zh-CN: 她被安排回到常规产检。
response.en: She is booked back into routine antenatal care.

name.zh-CN: 因为这项胎儿发现，预约孕37周择期剖宫产
name.en: Book an elective caesarean at 37 weeks because of the fetal finding

dose.zh-CN: 孕37周择期剖宫产，以便新生儿和心脏团队提前准备。
dose.en: Elective caesarean section at 37 weeks so that the neonatal and cardiac teams can be ready.

harm.zh-CN: 这项胎儿发现本身不是剖宫产或提前分娩的指征：产前诊断用来决定在哪里、由哪个团队接生（AHA 2014胎儿心脏病科学声明；ASE 2023），分娩方式按产科指征。没有产科指征而在37周择期手术，只会增加早期足月儿的呼吸问题和手术本身的风险，对胎儿的这项问题没有好处。
harm.en: The finding itself is not an indication for a caesarean or an early birth: prenatal diagnosis decides where and with which team the baby is born (AHA 2014 fetal cardiac disease statement; ASE 2023), and the mode follows obstetric indications. An elective operation at 37 weeks without an obstetric indication adds the breathing problems of early-term birth and the risks of surgery, with no benefit for the baby's condition.

name.zh-CN: 安排宝宝出生后的遗传学检测，以及血钙和T细胞检查
name.en: Arrange the baby's genetic test after birth, with calcium and T-cell counts

dose.zh-CN: 出生后取宝宝的血做染色体微阵列分析或22q11.2靶向检测（FISH或MLPA），同时查血钙和淋巴细胞亚群（T细胞计数）；需父母知情同意。
dose.en: After birth, the baby's blood for chromosomal microarray or a targeted 22q11.2 test (FISH or MLPA), with serum calcium and lymphocyte subsets (T-cell counts); with the parents' consent.

response.zh-CN: 检测已安排。本病例没有记录宝宝是否做过这些检查；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The tests are arranged. This case does not record whether the baby was tested; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 通知血库：宝宝需要辐照血液成分
name.en: Ask the blood bank to supply irradiated blood components for the baby

dose.zh-CN: 在排除22q11.2微缺失（或证实T细胞正常）之前，宝宝在手术前后需要的红细胞和血小板都用辐照成分（BSH 2020）。
dose.en: Until 22q11.2 deletion is excluded (or T cells are shown to be normal), any red cells or platelets the baby needs around an operation are irradiated (BSH 2020).

response.zh-CN: 血库已做标注：宝宝的血液成分需要辐照。本病例没有记录宝宝是否输过血、用的是什么血液成分；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The blood bank has flagged the baby for irradiated components. This case does not record whether the baby was transfused or which components were used; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 请小儿心胸外科会诊宝宝
name.en: Refer the baby to paediatric cardiothoracic surgery

dose.zh-CN: 当天请小儿心胸外科结合影像评估宝宝，商定手术方式和时机。
dose.en: Same-day review by paediatric cardiothoracic surgery with the imaging, to agree the operation and its timing.

response.zh-CN: 小儿心胸外科医生会结合影像来看宝宝，商量手术方式和时机。
response.en: The paediatric cardiothoracic surgeons will see the baby with the imaging and discuss the operation and its timing.

name.zh-CN: 宝宝出生后按常规观察，有症状先按反流或病毒感染处理，几周后门诊复查
name.en: Observe the newborn routinely, treat any symptoms as reflux or a viral illness, and review in clinic in a few weeks

dose.zh-CN: 增稠喂养，必要时雾化，4–6周后门诊复查。
dose.en: Thickened feeds, a nebuliser if needed, and a clinic review in 4–6 weeks.

harm.zh-CN: 新生儿出生后需要呼吸支持、哭闹或吃奶后咳嗽、喘鸣，首先要排除的就是产前已经看到的那处异常压迫气道；按反流或病毒感染等待，会延误影像检查和手术，而气道受压可能突然加重。
harm.en: When a newborn needs breathing support and coughs and wheezes after crying or feeds, the first thing to exclude is airway compression by the abnormality already seen before birth; waiting it out as reflux or a viral illness delays imaging and surgery, and the compression can worsen suddenly.

title.zh-CN: 问清这次怀孕和她本人的病史
title.en: Take the history of this pregnancy and her health

hint.zh-CN: 她现在孕几周、是第几次怀孕？前面的筛查超声怎么说？这次怀孕出过哪些问题、用过哪些药？她和家里人有什么病，尤其是心脏方面？
hint.en: How far along is she, and in which pregnancy? What did the earlier screening scans say? What has gone wrong in this pregnancy, and which medicines has she had? What illnesses do she and her family have — the heart above all?

guidance.zh-CN: 她坐在门诊，清醒，能自己回答。
guidance.en: She is sitting in clinic, alert and answering for herself.

title.en: Make sense of today's scan views

hint.zh-CN: 四腔心和流出道正常能排除什么、会漏掉什么？三血管气管切面上，主动脉弓和动脉导管各在气管哪一侧，有没有把气管围起来？两侧锁骨下动脉从哪里发出？
hint.en: What does a normal four-chamber and outflow view rule out, and what can it miss? In the three-vessel-and-trachea view, on which side of the trachea do the arch and the ductus run, and do they encircle it? Where do the subclavian arteries arise?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端或她身边调阅今天的超声报告，再到会诊板作答决策 1。
guidance.en: Read today's scan reports at a records terminal or at her side, then answer decision 1 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 决定发现异常后的下一步

hint.zh-CN: 单靠筛查切面能确定多少？哪些专科需要参与？哪些可能伴随的遗传问题值得在出生前讨论，什么检测能查到它们？
hint.en: How much can screening views alone settle? Which specialists need to be involved? Which associated genetic conditions are worth discussing before birth, and which test would detect them?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板上作答决策 2，然后安排相应的转诊。
guidance.en: Answer decision 2 on the case board, then make the referrals it calls for.

title.zh-CN: 咨询之后：为分娩和宝宝做计划
title.en: After counselling: plan the birth and the baby's care

hint.zh-CN: 夫妇的决定之后，哪些问题仍然悬而未决，什么时候还能回答？这项胎儿发现会不会改变分娩的时间和方式？谁需要在宝宝出生前就知道这个诊断？
hint.en: After the couple's decision, which questions stay open, and when can they still be answered? Does the finding change the timing or mode of birth? Who needs to know the diagnosis before the baby arrives?

guidance.zh-CN: 她做过遗传咨询，回到门诊。
guidance.en: She is back in clinic after genetic counselling.

title.zh-CN: 宝宝出生后：判断呼吸问题并处理
title.en: After the birth: act on the baby's breathing

hint.zh-CN: 出生后需要呼吸支持、哭和吃奶后咳嗽、偶尔喘鸣，和产前看到的气管压迹有什么关系？手术之前还需要弄清什么？下一步由谁来做？
hint.en: How do the need for breathing support, the cough after crying or feeds and the occasional wheeze relate to the tracheal indentation seen before birth? What must be known before any operation, and who takes the next step?

guidance.zh-CN: 她在产后病房；宝宝由新生儿团队照护，记录可在病历终端查看。
guidance.en: She is on the postnatal ward; the baby is with the neonatal team, and his records are at the records terminal.

title.zh-CN: 回看原报告的经过，与你的计划对照
title.en: Compare the report's course with your plan

hint.zh-CN: 原报告的做法和你的计划有哪些一致、哪些今天会不一样？还有哪些问题至今没有答案？
hint.en: Where does the report's course match your plan, and what would you do differently today? Which questions are still unanswered?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅原报告的后续经过。
guidance.en: Read the reported course at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 今天孕32+2周的超声：胎儿生长、羊水、胎盘位置、四腔心和流出道均正常。三血管气管切面上，主动脉弓走行于气管右侧，动脉导管在左侧；气管左侧另有一条对称的弓状结构，与之围成完整的血管环，呈“9”字形。两侧锁骨下动脉分别起自同侧的弓。哪种解剖最符合？
prompt.en: Today's scan at 32+2 weeks: growth, fluid, placental position, four-chamber view and outflow tracts are normal. In the three-vessel-and-trachea view the aortic arch runs to the right of the trachea and the ductus to the left; a second, symmetrical arch-like structure lies to the left of the trachea, and together they close a complete ring in a “9”-shaped configuration. Each subclavian artery arises from the arch on its own side. Which anatomy fits best?

need.zh-CN: 先问清她来就诊的原因和前面的筛查情况，再看今天的超声和三血管气管切面。
need.en: Ask why she has come and what the earlier screening scans showed, then read today's scan and the three-vessel-and-trachea view.

text.zh-CN: 双主动脉弓：左右两条弓从两侧环绕气管，各自发出同侧的锁骨下动脉
text.en: Double aortic arch: right and left arches encircle the trachea, each giving its own subclavian artery

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。两条弓分居气管两侧、各自发出同侧锁骨下动脉，气管和食管就被围在完整的血管环中。ISUOG 2023把三血管气管切面列入筛查，正是因为这类弓部异常位于四腔心平面之上。Bartsota等2023年的胎儿队列中，近一半双主动脉弓出生后左弓有闭锁段，所以两弓粗细要在出生后确认。
feedback.en: Right. Two arches straddle the trachea and each gives its own subclavian artery, so the trachea and oesophagus sit inside a complete ring. ISUOG 2023 puts the three-vessel-and-trachea view in the screen precisely because such arch anomalies lie above the four-chamber plane. In Bartsota and colleagues' 2023 fetal series, nearly half of double arches had an atretic left segment after birth, so the size of each arch is confirmed postnatally.

text.zh-CN: 右位主动脉弓伴迷走左锁骨下动脉：左锁骨下动脉起自气管后方的憩室，由左侧导管闭合成环
text.en: Right aortic arch with an aberrant left subclavian artery from a diverticulum behind the trachea, closed by a left ductus

feedback.zh-CN: 右位主动脉弓伴迷走左锁骨下动脉也能和左侧导管围成血管环，是最常见的“相似者”。但这里气管左侧另有一条弓状结构，两侧锁骨下动脉各自起自同侧的弓，而不是左锁骨下动脉从气管后方的憩室发出。Bartsota等（Ultrasound Obstet Gynecol 2023）报告过左弓闭锁的双主动脉弓在首次胎儿超声时被读成右位弓，本例记录的左侧弓状结构不支持这种读法。
feedback.en: A right arch with an aberrant left subclavian artery also closes a ring with a left ductus, and it is the commonest look-alike. Here, though, a second arch-like structure lies left of the trachea and each subclavian artery comes from its own arch, rather than the left one arising behind the trachea from a diverticulum. Bartsota and colleagues (Ultrasound Obstet Gynecol 2023) describe double arches with an atretic left segment first read as a right arch; the recorded left-sided structure argues against that reading here.

text.zh-CN: 镜像分支的右位主动脉弓：左侧导管起自左无名动脉，位于气管前方，不形成血管环
text.en: Right aortic arch with mirror-image branching: the left ductus arises from the left innominate artery in front of the trachea, with no ring

feedback.zh-CN: 镜像分支的右位弓、导管起自左无名动脉时，血管都在气管前方，不会把气管围住；在三血管气管切面上看不到气管后方闭合的环（ISUOG 2023的筛查切面）。本例记录了完整的血管环和气管左侧的第二条弓状结构，镜像分支解释不了。
feedback.en: With mirror-image branching and the ductus arising from the left innominate artery, the vessels stay in front of the trachea and do not encircle it; the three-vessel-and-trachea view (a screening view in ISUOG 2023) shows no ring closing behind it. This scan records a complete ring and a second arch-like structure to the left of the trachea, which mirror-image branching cannot explain.

text.zh-CN: 左位主动脉弓伴迷走右锁骨下动脉：右锁骨下动脉从气管后方绕行，没有完整的血管环
text.en: Left aortic arch with an aberrant right subclavian artery passing behind the trachea, with no complete ring

feedback.zh-CN: 迷走右锁骨下动脉是左位弓的常见变异，从气管后方绕行，但不形成完整的血管环。本例的主动脉弓走行于气管右侧，气管左侧另有一条结构把环闭合；按ISUOG 2023的三血管气管切面，先看弓在气管哪一侧，就能排除这个解释。
feedback.en: An aberrant right subclavian artery is a common variant of a left arch; it passes behind the trachea but forms no complete ring. Here the arch runs to the right of the trachea and a second structure on the left closes the ring; reading the three-vessel-and-trachea view as ISUOG 2023 describes — first which side of the trachea the arch lies on — rules this out.

prompt.zh-CN: 孕32+2周，第一次怀孕，胎儿双主动脉弓：气管从血管环中穿过并有压迹，两条弓均无血流梗阻，产前不能判断优势弓。她本人有β地中海贫血，本人和家里都没有心脏病。你现在安排什么？
prompt.en: A fetal double aortic arch at 32+2 weeks in her first pregnancy: the trachea passes through the ring with an indentation, neither arch is obstructed on colour Doppler, and the dominant arch cannot be identified. She has beta thalassaemia, and there is no heart disease in her or her family. What do you arrange now?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 1，看过弓部彩色多普勒与气管评估，并问过她本人和家族的病史。
need.en: Answer decision 1, read the arch colour Doppler and airway assessment, and ask about her own and her family's medical history first.

text.zh-CN: 现在转诊做胎儿超声心动图，提供遗传咨询和羊水染色体微阵列检测，并开始制定出生后计划
text.en: Refer now for a specialist fetal echocardiogram, offer genetic counselling with amniocentesis for microarray, and start a postnatal plan

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。筛查切面异常就是做胎儿超声心动图专科检查的指征（ASE 2023），以确认解剖并排除心内畸形。胎儿主动脉弓异常可伴22q11.2微缺失，应提供遗传咨询和能检出它的染色体微阵列（AHA 2014；22q11.2学会2023）。气管已有压迹，出生后计划要从现在开始写。
feedback.en: Right. An abnormal screening view is an indication for a specialist fetal echocardiogram (ASE 2023), to confirm the anatomy and look for intracardiac defects. A fetal arch anomaly can accompany 22q11.2 deletion, so offer genetic counselling and a microarray that detects it (AHA 2014; 22q11.2 Society 2023). The trachea is already indented, so the postnatal plan starts now.

text.zh-CN: 安慰她：四腔心和流出道都正常，两条弓的血流也通畅，继续常规产检，不需要再做专科检查
text.en: Reassure her: the four-chamber and outflow views are normal and both arches flow freely, so routine antenatal care and no specialist tests

feedback.zh-CN: 四腔心和流出道正常、血流通畅，都不能排除气道受压：ISUOG 2023把三血管气管切面列入筛查，就是因为弓部异常在四腔心平面看不到。这里血管环已经在气管上留下压迹，不转诊、不做计划，宝宝出生后的症状可能被延误识别。
feedback.en: Normal four-chamber and outflow views and free flow do not exclude airway compression: ISUOG 2023 adds the three-vessel-and-trachea view because arch anomalies are invisible in the four-chamber plane. Here the ring already indents the trachea; without referral and a plan, the baby's symptoms after birth may be recognised late.

text.zh-CN: 4周后再复查一次筛查超声，等血管长大看得更清楚，到时如果仍有血管环再转诊和做遗传咨询
text.en: Repeat the screening scan in four weeks, when the vessels are larger and clearer, and refer for counselling only if the ring is still there

feedback.zh-CN: 等待只会缩短咨询和做决定的时间：她已经孕32+2周，四周后接近足月。ASE 2023要求筛查异常时转诊做胎儿超声心动图专科检查，而不是重复筛查；产前不能判断优势弓也不是推迟的理由，那要靠出生后的影像来确定。
feedback.en: Waiting only shortens the time for counselling and decisions: she is already 32+2 weeks, and four weeks on she is near term. ASE 2023 asks for referral to a specialist fetal echocardiogram after an abnormal screen, not a repeat screen; and dominance that cannot be called before birth is settled by postnatal imaging, not by a later scan.

text.zh-CN: 转诊做胎儿超声心动图，并提供羊水常规染色体核型分析，核型正常就可以排除相关的染色体问题
text.en: Refer for fetal echocardiography and offer amniocentesis for a standard karyotype, since a normal karyotype rules out the relevant chromosomal problems

feedback.zh-CN: 转诊是对的，但常规核型分析看不到22q11.2微缺失——这正是主动脉弓异常最需要考虑的染色体问题。22q11.2学会2023年建议用染色体微阵列，或FISH、MLPA靶向检测来诊断；核型正常不能排除它。
feedback.en: Referral is right, but a standard karyotype cannot see a 22q11.2 deletion — the chromosomal question that matters most with an arch anomaly. The 22q11.2 Society's 2023 recommendations diagnose it by chromosomal microarray or a targeted FISH or MLPA test; a normal karyotype does not exclude it.

prompt.zh-CN: 遗传咨询讲解了双主动脉弓可能伴随的染色体异常（包括22q11.2微缺失），夫妇决定不做羊膜腔穿刺。这对宝宝意味着什么，你怎么安排？
prompt.en: After genetic counselling about the chromosomal abnormalities that may accompany a double aortic arch, including 22q11.2 deletion, the couple have declined amniocentesis. What does this mean for the baby, and what do you plan?

need.zh-CN: 先看遗传咨询记录，并问问她和丈夫对羊水穿刺的决定。
need.en: Read the genetic counselling note and ask her what the couple decided about amniocentesis first.

text.zh-CN: 尊重决定；22q11.2仍属未知，出生后查宝宝的基因、血钙和T细胞，排除前手术用辐照血
text.en: Respect their choice: 22q11.2 stays unknown, so test the baby after birth, check calcium and T cells, and irradiate blood until excluded

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。拒绝检测后状态是“未知”，不是“阴性”。22q11.2学会2023年建议出生后用微阵列或靶向检测诊断，并评估血钙和免疫功能；BSH 2020建议怀疑T细胞免疫缺陷的婴儿在心脏手术前尽量先查T淋巴细胞，否则输注的细胞成分血都要辐照，直到排除。
feedback.en: Right. A declined test leaves the status unknown, not negative. The 22q11.2 Society's 2023 recommendations diagnose it after birth by microarray or a targeted test and assess calcium and immunity; BSH 2020 asks for T-lymphocyte testing before cardiac surgery in an infant with suspected T-cell immunodeficiency where possible, and otherwise irradiated cellular components until it is excluded.

text.zh-CN: 孤立的双主动脉弓、四腔心又正常，伴22q11.2微缺失的可能很小，出生后不需要再做遗传学检测
text.en: An isolated double arch with a normal four-chamber view makes a deletion unlikely, so no genetic test is needed after birth

feedback.zh-CN: 可能性小不等于已经排除：22q11.2微缺失的心外表现（低钙、T细胞缺陷）在新生儿期可能并不明显，却直接影响手术用血。22q11.2学会2023年的建议用出生后的诊断性检测来回答这个问题；在没有结果时，BSH 2020的辐照血原则照样适用。
feedback.en: Less likely is not excluded: the extracardiac features of 22q11.2 deletion (low calcium, a T-cell defect) can be silent in a newborn, yet they change the blood used for surgery. The 22q11.2 Society's 2023 recommendations answer the question with a diagnostic test after birth, and without a result BSH 2020's irradiation rule still applies.

text.zh-CN: 改为给父母双方查22q11.2微缺失：父母都没有缺失，就可以认为宝宝没有，不必再给宝宝检测
text.en: Test both parents for the 22q11.2 deletion instead; if neither carries it, the baby's status is settled without testing the baby

feedback.zh-CN: 大多数22q11.2微缺失是宝宝自己新发生的，父母检测正常并不能排除宝宝有缺失（22q11.2学会2023）。父母检测的用处是确诊之后评估再发风险，不能代替对宝宝本人的诊断性检测。
feedback.en: Most 22q11.2 deletions arise new in the child, so normal results in the parents do not exclude one in the baby (22q11.2 Society 2023). Parental testing estimates the recurrence risk once a deletion is found; it cannot replace a diagnostic test of the baby.

text.zh-CN: 每次产检都继续劝他们做羊水穿刺，直到同意为止，因为外科医生必须先拿到结果才能计划手术
text.en: Keep pressing for amniocentesis at every visit until they agree, because the surgeons need the result before they can plan an operation

feedback.zh-CN: 产前检测是提供选择，不是强加：夫妇在充分咨询后拒绝，是正当的决定，反复施压会损害信任。手术计划并不依赖产前结果——22q11.2状态可以在出生后检测（22q11.2学会2023），在此之前按BSH 2020使用辐照血。
feedback.en: Prenatal testing is offered, not imposed: declining after full counselling is a valid choice, and pressure damages trust. Planning surgery does not depend on a prenatal result — the 22q11.2 status can be tested after birth (22q11.2 Society 2023), with irradiated blood under BSH 2020 until then.

prompt.zh-CN: 第一次怀孕，胎儿双主动脉弓，气管有压迹，两条弓血流通畅，夫妇拒绝了羊水穿刺。她有β地中海贫血，孕期有贫血和血糖问题，还出现过先兆早产。你怎样安排分娩？
prompt.en: Her first pregnancy, with a fetal double aortic arch that indents the trachea and unobstructed flow in both arches; the couple declined amniocentesis. She has beta thalassaemia, anaemia and blood-sugar problems in pregnancy, and threatened preterm labour. How do you plan the birth?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 3，并问清这次怀孕出过的问题。
need.en: Answer decision 3 and ask about the problems in this pregnancy first.

text.zh-CN: 计划足月分娩，分娩方式按产科指征，在新生儿团队事先知情、能安排超声心动图和气道评估的医院分娩
text.en: Plan a term birth, mode by obstetric indication, in a unit whose neonatal team knows the diagnosis and can arrange echo and airway review

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。产前诊断用来决定在哪里、由哪个团队接生（AHA 2014；ASE 2023围产期管理），而不是提前分娩；血管环本身不需要剖宫产。新生儿团队事先知情，出生后就能安排超声心动图并留意气道症状。原报告在孕39周剖宫产，指征没有记录。
feedback.en: Right. Prenatal diagnosis decides where and with which team the baby is born (AHA 2014; ASE 2023 perinatal planning), not an earlier birth, and the ring itself does not call for a caesarean. A neonatal team that knows the diagnosis arranges echocardiography and watches for airway symptoms. The report's team delivered by caesarean at 39 weeks; the indication is not recorded.

text.zh-CN: 孕37周择期剖宫产，这样新生儿和心脏团队能提前准备，宫缩和产程也不会让宝宝的气道受压更重
text.en: Book an elective caesarean at 37 weeks, so that the neonatal and cardiac teams are ready and labour cannot add to the airway compression

feedback.zh-CN: 血管环不是剖宫产的指征，产程也不会加重血管环对气道的压迫。没有产科指征而在37周择期手术，会增加早期足月儿的呼吸问题，本身也有手术风险；团队准备靠事先沟通的分娩计划实现（AHA 2014；ASE 2023）。
feedback.en: A vascular ring is not an indication for a caesarean, and labour does not tighten it around the airway. An elective operation at 37 weeks without an obstetric indication adds the breathing problems of early-term birth and the risks of surgery; the teams are made ready by an agreed birth plan (AHA 2014; ASE 2023).

text.zh-CN: 先打一个疗程促胎肺成熟的激素，孕34周提前分娩，好让外科在气管受到更多损伤之前尽早切断血管环
text.en: Give a course of antenatal steroids and deliver at 34 weeks, so the surgeons can divide the ring before the trachea is damaged further

feedback.zh-CN: 提前分娩换来的是早产的风险，而对血管环没有好处：手术时机取决于出生后的症状和影像，不取决于出生孕周。促胎肺成熟的激素是给近期内可能早产的孕妇用的，不是为了计划性提前分娩；产前诊断的作用是计划分娩地点和团队（AHA 2014；ASE 2023）。
feedback.en: An early birth trades in the risks of prematurity and does nothing for the ring: surgery is timed by the symptoms and imaging after birth, not by the gestation at birth. Antenatal steroids are for women likely to give birth preterm within days, not for a planned early delivery; prenatal diagnosis plans the place and team of birth (AHA 2014; ASE 2023).

text.zh-CN: 在当地医院常规分娩，宝宝和妈妈同室按常规护理，看着好就出院，6周时再约门诊超声心动图
text.en: Let her give birth at her local unit with routine newborn care, discharge the baby once well, and book an outpatient echocardiogram at six weeks

feedback.zh-CN: 气管已有压迹的完整血管环，宝宝出生后可能很快出现呼吸或喂养问题，需要能及时评估和处理的新生儿团队。AHA 2014和ASE 2023强调用产前诊断来计划出生后的评估；“看着好就出院、6周再看”等于放弃了产前诊断带来的准备时间。
feedback.en: A complete ring that already indents the trachea can cause breathing or feeding problems soon after birth, which need a neonatal team able to assess and act. AHA 2014 and ASE 2023 use the prenatal diagnosis to plan the newborn's assessment; 'home once well, echo at six weeks' throws away the preparation that prenatal diagnosis buys.

prompt.zh-CN: 宝宝孕39周剖宫产出生，男婴3120 g，5分钟Apgar评分10分。出生后需要高流量呼吸支持，哭闹或吃奶后咳嗽，偶有喘鸣。产前诊断为双主动脉弓，优势弓未明。你现在怎么做？
prompt.en: The baby was born by caesarean at 39 weeks: a 3120 g boy, Apgar 10 at 5 minutes. He needed high-flow respiratory support after birth, and he coughs after crying or feeds, with occasional wheeze. The prenatal diagnosis was a double aortic arch with the dominant side unknown. What do you do now?

need.zh-CN: 先看分娩记录和新生儿病程记录，并问问她宝宝的咳嗽和吃奶情况。
need.en: Read the delivery record and the newborn notes, and ask her about the baby's cough and feeds first.

text.zh-CN: 做CT血管成像，明确哪条弓占优势和气道受压情况，并请小儿心胸外科切断非优势弓
text.en: Get CT angiography of the arches and airway, and refer him to paediatric cardiothoracic surgery to divide the non-dominant arch

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。出生后需要呼吸支持、哭和吃奶后咳嗽、喘鸣，提示血管环压迫气管，需要手术解除。产前不能判断优势弓，Bartsota等2023年的研究也表明两弓情况要靠出生后的CT确认；外科在不影响头臂血管供血的位置切断较细的非优势弓，由优势弓承担循环。在22q11.2排除之前，手术用血按BSH 2020辐照。
feedback.en: Right. A need for breathing support with cough after crying or feeds and wheeze means the ring is compressing the trachea and needs surgical release. Dominance could not be called before birth, and Bartsota and colleagues (2023) show that postnatal CT settles the arches; the surgeon divides the smaller, non-dominant arch where flow to the head and arm vessels is preserved, leaving the dominant arch to carry the circulation. Until 22q11.2 is excluded, blood for surgery is irradiated (BSH 2020).

text.zh-CN: 先按胃食管反流或病毒性喘息处理：增稠喂养、必要时雾化，4到6周后门诊复查再决定
text.en: Treat it first as reflux or a viral wheeze: thickened feeds, a nebuliser if needed, and a clinic review in four to six weeks

feedback.zh-CN: 对已知有完整血管环、气管有压迹的新生儿，咳嗽、喘鸣和需要呼吸支持首先是气道受压的表现。按反流或病毒感染等待，会把需要影像和手术的问题拖成急症；气道受压可能突然加重。产前诊断的意义正在于此时不必再走弯路。
feedback.en: In a newborn known to have a complete ring indenting the trachea, cough, wheeze and the need for breathing support are airway compression until proved otherwise. Waiting it out as reflux or a viral illness turns an imaging-and-surgery problem into an emergency, and the compression can worsen suddenly. The prenatal diagnosis exists so that this detour is not needed.

text.zh-CN: 继续呼吸支持，把手术推迟到6到12个月，等两条弓和气管长大一些，手术更安全时再做
text.en: Keep him on support and delay surgery until six to twelve months, when the arches and trachea are bigger and the operation is safer

feedback.zh-CN: 有症状的血管环不会随着长大而松开：压迫一直存在，长期依赖呼吸支持本身就有风险。解剖明确以后，有症状的血管环应尽早手术，不必等待；本例的手术在出生后第18天进行。
feedback.en: A symptomatic ring does not loosen as he grows: the compression persists, and prolonged breathing support carries its own risks. Once the anatomy is defined, a symptomatic ring is divided without waiting; in this case the operation was at 18 days of age.

text.zh-CN: 不再做影像，直接请外科切断右侧的弓，因为右位主动脉弓才是不正常的那一侧
text.en: Ask the surgeons to divide the right arch without more imaging, because a right-sided aortic arch is the abnormal one

feedback.zh-CN: 双主动脉弓的两条弓都“异常”，要切的是较细的非优势弓；若误切优势弓，就只剩较细的那条弓给头臂血管和降主动脉供血。产前不能判断优势弓，必须先用CT等影像明确（Bartsota等2023）。本例CT证实右弓占优势，切断的是左弓。
feedback.en: In a double arch both arches are 'abnormal'; the one to divide is the smaller, non-dominant arch, and dividing the dominant one would leave the smaller arch to carry the blood to the head, arms and descending aorta. Dominance could not be called before birth, so imaging such as CT must settle it first (Bartsota and colleagues 2023). Here CT showed right-arch dominance, and the left arch was divided.

text.zh-CN: 问清孕周与胎次、前面的筛查超声、孕期的贫血、血糖和先兆早产、用药、她本人的病史和家族心脏病史
text.en: Took the history of the gestation and parity, the earlier screening scans, anaemia, blood sugar and threatened preterm labour in this pregnancy, her medicines, her own conditions and heart disease in the family

text.zh-CN: 在孕32+2周就诊时看过生长与四腔心、流出道报告、三血管气管切面和弓部彩色多普勒
text.en: Read the growth, four-chamber and outflow report, the three-vessel-and-trachea view and the arch colour Doppler at the 32+2-week visit

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即从三血管气管切面判断出弓部解剖（决策 1）
text.en: Read the arch anatomy from the three-vessel-and-trachea view at the first attempt (decision 1)

text.zh-CN: 产前就转诊胎儿心脏专科，做详细胎儿超声心动图并制定出生后计划
text.en: Referred her before birth to fetal cardiology for a detailed fetal echocardiogram and a postnatal plan

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对发现异常后的安排，并安排了遗传咨询（决策 2）
text.en: Chose the right next steps after the finding at the first attempt and arranged genetic counselling (decision 2)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把拒绝羊水穿刺理解为“状态未知”，并安排宝宝出生后的遗传学、血钙和T细胞检查（决策 3）
text.en: Treated the declined amniocentesis as an unknown status at the first attempt and arranged the baby's genetic, calcium and T-cell tests after birth (decision 3)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即制定足月分娩计划，与新生儿科和小儿心脏科共同写好计划，交代出生后的危险信号，并请产科复核贫血和血糖（决策 4）
text.en: Planned a term birth at the first attempt, agreed a written plan with the neonatal and cardiology teams, gave the parents the warning signs and had her anaemia and glucose reviewed (decision 4)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把宝宝的症状判断为气道受压并选择影像加手术（决策 5），并看过CT血管成像
text.en: Read the baby's symptoms as airway compression needing imaging and surgery at the first attempt (decision 5), and read the CT angiogram

text.zh-CN: 宝宝出生后有症状时，及时请小儿心胸外科会诊
text.en: Referred the symptomatic newborn to paediatric cardiothoracic surgery in time

text.zh-CN: 在22q11.2微缺失排除之前，通知血库为宝宝准备辐照血液成分
text.en: Asked the blood bank for irradiated components for the baby while 22q11.2 deletion was not excluded

text.zh-CN: 没有按常规产检打发她，没有因这项发现预约37周剖宫产，也没有把宝宝的症状当作反流或病毒性喘息观察
text.en: Did not send her back to routine care, book a 37-week caesarean for the finding, or watch the baby's symptoms as reflux or a viral wheeze

text.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge模式向她解释胎儿的发现、不确定之处和检测选择，并尊重夫妇的决定
text.en: Explained the fetal finding, what is uncertain and the testing choice to her by the Calgary–Cambridge guide, and respected the couple's decision

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge指南评价与曹女士的两次谈话（超声当天、遗传咨询之后）。开始：自我介绍，先问她已经听到了什么，是否希望丈夫在场。收集信息：让她说出担心——宝宝心脏是不是有大问题，是不是她用的药或得新冠造成的——予以承认，不责备，也不作虚假保证。解释与计划：用通俗的话、一小段一小段地说明：两条血管在宝宝气管周围形成了一个环，对气管有压迫；血流是通畅的；哪一侧更粗出生前看不清；有些宝宝出生后需要手术。不带倾向地说明可选的遗传学检测能查什么、查不出什么、有什么风险，尊重夫妇的决定，并说明不做检测意味着什么（问题留到宝宝出生后检测）。商定分娩计划，告诉她出生后的危险信号（呼吸有响声或费力、吃奶时咳嗽或呛咳、嘴唇发紫、呼吸停顿）。结束：总结，请她复述要点，告诉她怎样联系团队。本病例没有记录医生和她说了什么。
judgeGuidance.en: Judge the two conversations with Ms Cao (at the scan and after counselling) by the Calgary–Cambridge guide. Initiating: introduce yourself, ask what she has already been told and whether she wants her husband there. Gathering: let her voice her worries — whether the baby's heart is seriously wrong, whether her medicines or the COVID infection caused it — and acknowledge them without blame or false reassurance. Explanation and planning: in plain words and small chunks, explain that two blood vessels form a ring around the baby's windpipe and press on it, that blood flows well through them, that which side is larger cannot be seen before birth, and that some babies need an operation after birth; explain non-directively what the genetic test on offer can and cannot show and its risk, respect the couple's decision, and say what declining means (the question is answered by testing the baby after birth); agree the birth plan and the warning signs after birth (noisy or laboured breathing, coughing or choking with feeds, blue lips, pauses in breathing). Closing: summarise, check understanding by teach-back and say how to reach the team. This case does not record what was said to her.

name.zh-CN: 温医生（胎儿医学主治医师，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“四腔心正常能排除什么，会漏掉什么？”“主动脉弓在气管哪一侧？另一侧是什么把环闭合的？”“两侧锁骨下动脉的起源怎样帮你区分不同的血管环？”“血流通畅能不能回答气道的问题？”“哪种检测能查出22q11.2微缺失，哪种查不出？”“夫妇拒绝羊水穿刺以后，什么还没有答案，什么时候能回答？”“这项发现会不会改变分娩的时间和方式？”“宝宝吃奶后咳嗽、需要高流量支持——是什么在压迫什么？外科医生手术前必须知道什么？”可以讲ISUOG 2023、ASE 2023、AHA 2014、22q11.2学会2023年建议和BSH 2020的相关原则。原报告的经过是历史记录，在病例结束时才展示。不提前说出诊断、任何决策的正确选项或结局。以下内容本病例没有记录，不要替它补上：她的生命体征和查体、胎儿测量值、血红蛋白、铁蛋白和血糖结果、地中海贫血的类型、配偶筛查、拒绝羊水穿刺的原因、剖宫产指征、宝宝的遗传学、血钙和T细胞结果，以及手术细节。
knowledge.en: A Socratic teacher who asks only about what the learner has already found, for example: 'What does a normal four-chamber view rule out — and what can it miss?', 'Which side of the trachea is the arch on, and what closes the circle on the other side?', 'How do the subclavian arteries help you tell one ring from another?', 'The flow is unobstructed — does that settle the airway question?', 'Which test finds a 22q11.2 deletion, and which misses it?', 'The couple said no to amniocentesis — what is still open, and when can it be answered?', 'Does this finding change when or how she gives birth?', 'He coughs after feeds and needed high-flow support — what is pressing on what, and what must the surgeon know before operating?'. May explain the principles of ISUOG 2023, ASE 2023, AHA 2014, the 22q11.2 Society's 2023 recommendations and BSH 2020. The report's course is a historical record, shown at the end of the case. Never states the diagnosis, a decision's correct option or the outcome early. Not recorded in this case, and never to be supplied: her vital signs and examination, the fetal measurements, her haemoglobin, ferritin and glucose results, the type of thalassaemia, her partner's screen, the reasons for declining amniocentesis, the indication for the caesarean, the baby's genetic, calcium and T-cell results, and the surgical details.

name.zh-CN: 阮助产士（化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 产前门诊助产士。交班（ISBAR）：26岁，第一次怀孕，孕32+2周，来做产前超声；这次孕晚期超声发现胎儿大血管结构需要进一步核对。这次就诊没有记录她的血压、体重等观察数据。可以带学员到病历终端，帮忙预约转诊和遗传咨询，转达她的问题。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到没有记录的内容（她的血压、体重、血液化验结果）时，如实说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Antenatal clinic midwife. Handover (ISBAR): 26, first pregnancy, 32+2 weeks, here for her antenatal scan; this late-pregnancy scan has shown a fetal great-vessel finding that needs clarifying. No observations (blood pressure, weight) are recorded for this visit. Can show the learner to the records terminal, book referrals and genetic counselling, and pass on her questions. Reads back requests, reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded (her blood pressure, her weight, her blood results).

name.zh-CN: 陆医生（小儿心脏科，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 小儿心脏科（胎儿心脏）会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的超声和宝宝的记录。可以讲：三血管气管切面上主动脉弓和动脉导管与气管的位置关系；双主动脉弓、右位主动脉弓伴迷走左锁骨下动脉和镜像右位弓在图像上有什么不同；为什么产前常常判断不了优势弓，出生后要靠超声心动图和CT血管成像确认；新生儿气管受压的表现（呼吸有响声、吃奶时咳嗽或呛咳、需要呼吸支持）；为什么外科切断较细的非优势弓。在决策 1之前不说出诊断，不补充病例没有记录的测量值。
knowledge.en: Paediatric cardiologist (fetal cardiology) who interprets only the scans and the baby's records the learner has read. Can explain: how the arch and the ductus sit around the trachea in the three-vessel-and-trachea view; how a double arch, a right arch with an aberrant left subclavian artery and a mirror-image right arch differ on the images; why the dominant arch often cannot be called before birth and is confirmed by echocardiography and CT angiography afterwards; how tracheal compression shows itself in a newborn (noisy breathing, coughing or choking with feeds, needing breathing support); and why the surgeon divides the smaller, non-dominant arch. Does not state the diagnosis before decision 1 and adds no measurement the case does not record.

name.zh-CN: 秦医生（临床遗传科，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 临床遗传科医生，只解读学员已经看过的咨询记录和遗传学结果。可以讲：胎儿主动脉弓异常可能伴随的染色体问题，首先是22q11.2微缺失；染色体微阵列、FISH或MLPA能查出它，常规核型分析查不出；多数微缺失是孩子新发生的，父母正常并不能排除；不带倾向的遗传咨询和父母拒绝检测的权利；状态未知时宝宝出生后要做的事——遗传学检测、血钙、T细胞计数，以及手术用辐照血（22q11.2学会2023；BSH 2020）。不补充病例没有记录的结果。
knowledge.en: Clinical geneticist who interprets only the counselling note and the genetic records the learner has read. Can explain: the chromosomal conditions that may accompany a fetal arch anomaly, 22q11.2 deletion above all; that chromosomal microarray, FISH or MLPA detect it and a standard karyotype does not; that most deletions arise new in the child, so normal parents do not exclude it; non-directive counselling and the parents' right to decline; and what the newborn needs while the status is unknown — a genetic test, calcium, T-cell counts and irradiated blood for surgery (22q11.2 Society 2023; BSH 2020). Adds no result the case does not record.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：孕晚期发现的胎儿双主动脉弓
title.en: Debrief: a fetal double aortic arch found late in pregnancy

conclusion.zh-CN: 26岁初孕妇，有β地中海贫血，孕期贫血、血糖问题和先兆早产（用过硝苯地平、地屈孕酮和倍他米松），早、中孕筛查未发现心脏问题。孕32+2周超声：生长、羊水、胎盘位置、四腔心和流出道正常，三血管气管切面见右位主动脉弓、左侧导管和气管左侧的对称弓状结构围成完整血管环，两侧锁骨下动脉各自起自同侧弓——胎儿双主动脉弓；气管有压迹，两弓血流通畅，优势弓产前不能判断。夫妇拒绝了针对22q11.2微缺失等的羊水检查。孕39周剖宫产，男婴3120 g，5分钟Apgar 10分；出生后需高流量呼吸支持，哭闹或吃奶后咳嗽、偶有喘鸣；CT血管成像证实右弓优势、气管受压，出生第18天切断左弓；6月龄无呼吸困难、发绀或喉鸣，生长发育正常。按现行指南：发现后转诊胎儿超声心动图并提供含微阵列的遗传咨询，足月分娩、方式按产科指征，出生后检测22q11.2、手术用血辐照，症状出现即影像确认后切断非优势弓。
conclusion.en: A 26-year-old in her first pregnancy, with beta thalassaemia, anaemia, blood-sugar problems and threatened preterm labour, was scanned at 32+2 weeks; earlier screening had not flagged the heart. Four-chamber and outflow views were normal; the three-vessel-and-trachea view showed a right arch, a left ductus and a symmetrical arch-like structure left of the trachea closing a complete ring, each subclavian from its own arch: a fetal double aortic arch indenting the trachea, flow free, dominance unknown. The couple declined amniocentesis. A 3120 g boy born by caesarean at 39 weeks (Apgar 10 at 5 minutes) needed high-flow support and coughed after crying or feeds with occasional wheeze; CT angiography showed right-arch dominance and tracheal compression, and the left arch was divided at 18 days. At six months: no dyspnoea, cyanosis or stridor. Today: fetal echo, microarray counselling, a term birth, postnatal 22q11.2 testing with irradiated blood, prompt division of the non-dominant arch.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 四腔心正常回答的是心腔的问题，不是主动脉弓的问题：本例的异常在更高的一个平面——三血管气管切面。
keyReasoning.en: A normal four-chamber view answers a question about the chambers, not the arches: here the abnormality lay one plane higher, in the three-vessel-and-trachea view.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 对着气管读主动脉弓：气管右侧一条弓、左侧一条导管，再加上左侧把环闭合的第二条弓状结构，说明气管和食管被两条弓围住。
keyReasoning.en: Read the arch against the trachea: an arch on the right, a ductus on the left and a second arch-like vessel on the left closing the circle mean two arches around the trachea and oesophagus.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 锁骨下动脉区分不同的血管环：各自起自同侧弓，指向双主动脉弓；左锁骨下动脉从气管后方的憩室发出，则指向右位弓伴迷走左锁骨下动脉。
keyReasoning.en: The subclavian arteries tell the rings apart: each from its own arch points to a double arch; a left subclavian artery from a diverticulum behind the trachea points to a right arch with an aberrant artery.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血流通畅不等于安全：血流说明的是两条弓，气管压迹说明的才是气道——出生后出问题的正是气道。
keyReasoning.en: Free flow is not reassurance: the flow describes the arches, while the tracheal indentation describes the airway — the problem that appeared after birth.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 拒绝的检测是要带下去的空白，而不是阴性：22q11.2的问题转到了新生儿身上，牵涉血钙、免疫和手术用血。
keyReasoning.en: A declined test is a gap carried forward, not a negative: the 22q11.2 question passes to the newborn, with consequences for calcium, immunity and the blood used for surgery.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 新生儿需要呼吸支持，加上哭和吃奶后咳嗽、喘鸣，是血管环在“表态”；外科切断哪一条弓，要先由影像确定哪一条占优势。
keyReasoning.en: In the newborn, breathing support with cough after crying or feeds and wheeze is the ring declaring itself; imaging must show which arch is dominant before the surgeon divides the other.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告，而且本版本的患者事实只来自1.0.0版的提取，尚未对照原文全文核对：它不能说明产前诊断是否改变了宝宝的病程，22q11.2的问题也仍然没有答案。原报告的处理作为历史事实保留；决策、干预和评分依据现行指南设计，属于教学设计。遗传咨询的时间和CT检查的日龄没有记录，本病例把咨询放在超声门诊之后、把CT放在宝宝出生后的头几周；病例中的患者是母亲，宝宝的经过通过记录查阅。
boundaries.en: A single case report, and in this version its patient facts come only from the version 1.0.0 extraction, not yet checked against the full article: it cannot show whether prenatal diagnosis changed the baby's course, and the 22q11.2 question stays open. The report's management is kept as historical fact; the decisions, interventions and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design. The timing of the genetic counselling and the baby's age at the CT are not recorded, so the case places the counselling after the scan visit and the CT in the first weeks of life; the mother is the patient in the case, and the baby's course is read from records.

unknowns.zh-CN: β地中海贫血的类型，孕期血红蛋白、红细胞指数和铁蛋白的数值，以及配偶的地中海贫血筛查结果。
unknowns.en: The type of her beta thalassaemia, her haemoglobin, red cell indices and ferritin in pregnancy, and her partner's thalassaemia screen.

unknowns.zh-CN: “血糖问题”的性质、检查方式、数值和处理，以及怀孕前是否有糖尿病。
unknowns.en: The nature, tests, values and treatment of the 'blood-sugar problems', and whether diabetes predated the pregnancy.

unknowns.zh-CN: 先兆早产发生的孕周，硝苯地平、地屈孕酮和倍他米松的剂量与用药时间，以及孕早期新冠感染的轻重。
unknowns.en: When the threatened preterm labour happened, the doses and timing of nifedipine, dydrogesterone and betamethasone, and how severe the early COVID infection was.

unknowns.zh-CN: 她的生命体征和查体，胎儿生长测量值，以及是否另有胎儿超声心动图专科报告。
unknowns.en: Her vital signs and examination, the fetal biometry, and whether a separate specialist fetal echocardiogram was done.

unknowns.zh-CN: 拒绝羊水穿刺的原因；宝宝出生后是否做过遗传学检测、血钙和T细胞检查——22q11.2微缺失既未证实也未排除。
unknowns.en: Why the couple declined amniocentesis; whether the baby had a genetic test, calcium or T-cell counts after birth — a 22q11.2 deletion is neither confirmed nor excluded.

unknowns.zh-CN: 剖宫产的指征和麻醉方式；高流量呼吸支持的时长；CT检查时的日龄、两弓管径和气管狭窄程度；出生后超声心动图。
unknowns.en: The indication and anaesthetic for the caesarean; how long the high-flow support lasted; his age at the CT, the size of each arch and the degree of tracheal narrowing; any postnatal echocardiogram.

unknowns.zh-CN: 手术入路、是否切断动脉导管（韧带）、是否输血及用了何种血液成分、术后经过，以及6月龄以后的随访。
unknowns.en: The surgical approach, whether the ductus (ligament) was divided, whether he was transfused and with which components, the post-operative course, and any follow-up after six months.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 筛查切面（ISUOG 2023胎儿心脏筛查指南更新版）：基础筛查除四腔心外，还包括左右流出道、三血管切面和三血管气管切面，因为主动脉弓和大血管异常位于四腔心平面之上。本例早孕和中孕的筛查超声都没有发现心脏问题；孕32+2周时四腔心和流出道正常，异常只出现在三血管气管切面。
teachingPoints.en: Screening views (ISUOG 2023 updated fetal cardiac screening guideline): the basic screen adds the left and right outflow tracts and the three-vessel and three-vessel-and-trachea views to the four-chamber view, because arch and great-vessel anomalies lie above the four-chamber plane. Here the first- and second-trimester screening scans had not flagged the heart; at 32+2 weeks the four-chamber and outflow views were normal and only the three-vessel-and-trachea view was abnormal.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 读懂血管环：气管右侧的主动脉弓加左侧动脉导管可以围成环；气管左侧再有一条弓、两侧锁骨下动脉各自起自同侧的弓，提示双主动脉弓，而不是右位主动脉弓伴迷走左锁骨下动脉。Bartsota等的伦敦队列（Ultrasound Obstet Gynecol 2023，79例胎儿）中，48.6%出生后左弓有闭锁段，5.1%在首次胎儿超声时被诊断为右位主动脉弓；两弓粗细和优势侧要靠出生后的CT确定——本例产前也无法判断优势弓。
teachingPoints.en: Reading the ring: a right-sided arch with a left ductus can close a ring around the trachea; a second arch to the left, with each subclavian artery from its own arch, makes it a double aortic arch rather than a right arch with an aberrant left subclavian artery. In Bartsota and colleagues' London series (Ultrasound Obstet Gynecol 2023; 79 fetuses), 48.6% had an atretic left arch segment after birth and 5.1% were first diagnosed as a right aortic arch, so the arch sizes and the dominant side are settled by CT after birth — as here, where dominance could not be called before birth.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 遗传学（AHA 2014胎儿心脏病科学声明；22q11.2学会2023年儿童临床实践建议）：胎儿主动脉弓异常应提供遗传咨询和产前诊断检测；染色体微阵列（或FISH、MLPA靶向检测）能检出常规核型分析看不到的22q11.2微缺失。是否检测由父母决定：这对夫妇拒绝了羊膜腔穿刺，微缺失既未证实也未排除，问题转到出生后——宝宝需要遗传学检测、血钙和T细胞（淋巴细胞亚群）检查。本病例没有记录宝宝是否做过这些检查。
teachingPoints.en: Genetics (AHA 2014 fetal cardiac disease statement; 22q11.2 Society 2023 recommendations for children): a fetal arch anomaly is a reason to offer genetic counselling and diagnostic testing, and chromosomal microarray (or a targeted FISH or MLPA test) detects the 22q11.2 deletion that a standard karyotype misses. The choice is the parents': this couple declined amniocentesis, so the deletion is neither confirmed nor excluded and the question passes to the newborn — a genetic test, calcium and T-cell (lymphocyte subset) counts. This case does not record whether the baby was tested.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 手术用血（BSH 2020辐照血液成分指南）：怀疑T细胞免疫缺陷的婴儿（例如尚未排除22q11.2微缺失）在心脏手术前应尽量先查T淋巴细胞；来不及时，在排除之前输注的细胞成分血都要辐照，以预防输血相关移植物抗宿主病。本例宝宝在出生第18天手术，正处在这个时间窗内；是否输过血没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Blood for surgery (BSH 2020 guideline on irradiated blood components): an infant with a suspected T-cell immunodeficiency, such as an unexcluded 22q11.2 deletion, should have T-lymphocyte testing before cardiac surgery where possible; otherwise cellular blood components are irradiated until it is excluded, to prevent transfusion-associated graft-versus-host disease. The baby's operation at 18 days fell inside that window; whether he was transfused is not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 分娩计划（AHA 2014；ASE 2023围产期管理）：产前诊断用来决定在哪里、由哪个团队接生，而不是提前分娩。四腔心和流出道正常、血流通畅时，血管环应计划足月分娩、方式按产科指征，新生儿团队事先知道诊断，并写好出生后超声心动图和气道症状的处理计划。原报告在孕39周剖宫产，指征没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Planning the birth (AHA 2014; ASE 2023 perinatal planning): prenatal diagnosis decides where, and with which team, the baby is born — not to bring the birth forward. With normal four-chamber and outflow views and free flow, a ring calls for a planned term birth with the mode set by obstetric indications, a neonatal team that knows the diagnosis, and a written plan for echocardiography and for airway symptoms. The report's team delivered by caesarean at 39 weeks; the indication is not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 新生儿：压迫气管的完整血管环表现为喉鸣或喘鸣、哭闹或吃奶时咳嗽、呛咳，出生头几天可能需要呼吸支持。出现这些症状时，应做CT血管成像明确优势弓和气道受压，由外科切断非优势弓，而不是按胃食管反流或病毒性喘息处理。本例宝宝出生后需要高流量呼吸支持，哭闹或吃奶后咳嗽、偶有喘鸣；CT示右弓优势、气管受压，出生第18天切断左弓；6月龄时无呼吸困难、发绀或喉鸣。
teachingPoints.en: The newborn: a complete ring that compresses the trachea shows itself as stridor or wheeze, coughing or choking after crying or feeds and, in the first days, a need for breathing support. These symptoms call for CT angiography to show the dominant arch and the airway, and surgical division of the non-dominant arch — not treatment for reflux or a viral wheeze. Here the baby needed high-flow support and coughed after crying or feeds with occasional wheeze; CT showed right-arch dominance and tracheal compression, and the left arch was divided at 18 days; at six months he had no dyspnoea, cyanosis or stridor.

unknowns.zh-CN: 先兆早产发生的孕周，硝苯地平、地屈孕酮和倍他米松的剂量与用药时间，以及孕早期新冠感染的轻重。
unknowns.en: When the threatened preterm labour happened, the doses and timing of nifedipine, dydrogesterone and betamethasone, and how severe the early COVID infection was.

unknowns.zh-CN: 她的生命体征和查体，胎儿生长测量值，以及是否另有胎儿超声心动图专科报告。
unknowns.en: Her vital signs and examination, the fetal biometry, and whether a separate specialist fetal echocardiogram was done.

unknowns.zh-CN: 拒绝羊水穿刺的原因；宝宝出生后是否做过遗传学检测、血钙和T细胞检查——22q11.2微缺失既未证实也未排除。
unknowns.en: Why the couple declined amniocentesis; whether the baby had a genetic test, calcium or T-cell counts after birth — a 22q11.2 deletion is neither confirmed nor excluded.

unknowns.zh-CN: 剖宫产的指征和麻醉方式；高流量呼吸支持的时长；CT检查时的日龄、两弓管径和气管狭窄程度；出生后超声心动图。
unknowns.en: The indication and anaesthetic for the caesarean; how long the high-flow support lasted; his age at the CT, the size of each arch and the degree of tracheal narrowing; any postnatal echocardiogram.

unknowns.zh-CN: 手术入路、是否切断动脉导管（韧带）、是否输血及用了何种血液成分、术后经过，以及6月龄以后的随访。
unknowns.en: The surgical approach, whether the ductus (ligament) was divided, whether he was transfused and with which components, the post-operative course, and any follow-up after six months.
